request: Require every callback in the concurrent traversal API to own its captured state with a static lifetime, so our integration can keep that state alive without checking the caller's stack.

source.request: Require every callback in the concurrent traversal API to own its captured state with a static lifetime, so our integration can keep that state alive without checking the caller's stack.
source.settled: The parallel walker permits callbacks to borrow caller-owned data, simplifying shared initialization with serial walking.
source.why: Requiring owned static captures removes the ability to use caller-borrowed data that the ticket added.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
